# Sonolith local API (v1.0.0, draft)

> Sonolith is a desktop YouTube Music client for Linux and Windows. Its local API lets other programs on the same
> computer see and control playback, the queue, the library, search, and lyrics with timings, with live events.
> Apps must register and the user approves them on a consent screen. This file is a compact summary for writing an
> integration; the full spec is SPEC.md (https://github.com/opecko/sonolith/blob/master/api/SPEC.md).

## Connect

- Linux: Unix domain stream socket `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/sonolith/api.sock` (fallback `/tmp/sonolith-<uid>/api.sock`;
  check the dir is yours and 0700).
- Windows: named pipe; read its name from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Sonolith\api\discovery.json` (`path`), never build it.
  Check the pipe server process id equals `pid` in that file before sending the token, when you can.
- Discovery file (Linux: `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/sonolith/discovery.json`):
  `{"apiVersion":"1.0.0","appVersion":"2.4.0","transport":"unix"|"pipe","path":"…","pid":4242,"startedAt":1793021000000}`.
- No endpoint = Sonolith not running or API off (Settings → Connected apps → "Allow other apps to connect"). Retry
  with backoff 1 s doubling to 60 s, ±20% jitter. Never start Sonolith yourself more than once per user action.
  Never delete the socket file.

## Protocol

- JSON-RPC 2.0, params by name (object) only, one UTF-8 JSON message per line (`\n`), max 1 MiB per message.
- No batches. Request ids are strings or integers. Responses can come in any order; match by `id`.
- Sonolith sends only responses and notifications (events), never requests.
- Half-closing your write side is fine (shell pipes): Sonolith answers, delivers a pending `registration.resolved`,
  then closes.
- Unknown params are rejected (InvalidParams/unknownParam). Clients MUST ignore unknown result fields and unknown
  notifications.
- Every field the schema defines is always present in results/events; `null` = unknown / not applicable.
- Positions/lengths: integer ms, fields end in `Ms`. Timestamps: epoch ms, fields end in `At`. `*Text` fields are
  display-only English strings (hl=en); never parse them. Ids are opaque YouTube ids; always keep `type` with `id`.
- Paging: `{cursor?, limit? (1–100, default 50)}` -> `{items, nextCursor|null}`. A page may be shorter than `limit`
  even when more follow; continue until `nextCursor` is null. `InvalidParams` reason `cursorExpired` = restart.
- Queue and playlist items are entries with their own `entryId` (not the item's `id`): the same song twice = two
  entries. `queue.move`, `queue.remove` and `playlist.removeTracks` take `entryId`s and change exactly those entries.
- `apiVersion` in register/hello is the `MAJOR.MINOR` you wrote against, e.g. "1.0". Minor versions only add things.

## Registration flow

1. Only after a user action ("Connect to Sonolith" button): `app.register {appId, name, description, publisher,
   homepage?, icon? (PNG data URI ≤ 65536 chars), scopes: [{scope, required, reason}], apiVersion}`.
2. Result `{status:"pending", requestId, expiresAt}`. Keep the SAME connection open (closing cancels it). The user
   sees a notification and a consent screen with your name, publisher, icon, app identity, and one line per scope
   with your `reason`; optional scopes can be unticked. Expires after 5 min.
3. Wait for notification `registration.resolved {requestId, kind, status, token, grantedScopes, retryAfterMs}`:
   - `approved`: store `token` (sent only once) in a secret store (Linux Secret Service, Windows Credential
     Manager/DPAPI; fallback: user-only file), then `session.hello`.
   - `denied`: cooldown (`retryAfterMs`: 10 min, then 1 h, then 24 h). `blocked`: stop. `expired`: offer to retry.
4. Every connection: `session.hello {appId, token, apiVersion}` first. Sonolith finishes it before reading the
   next line, so you may pipeline requests after it.
   - Unauthorized / NotRegistered -> delete token, show "Disconnected from Sonolith", wait for the user.
   - RegistrationPending (reason identityChanged) -> your app identity changed; keep the connection open,
     wait for `registration.resolved` kind "identity", then hello again with the same token.
5. More scopes later: `app.requestScopes {scopes}` (only after a user action) -> pending/granted, then
   `registration.resolved` kind "scopes" and `session.scopesChanged`.
6. "Disconnect from Sonolith" button (REQUIRED): `app.unregister`, then delete the token (even if Sonolith is down).
7. On `session.revoked`: stop, delete the token, show "Disconnected from Sonolith". Never re-register automatically.

Minimal session (one line each):

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"session.hello","params":{"appId":"com.example.mybar","token":"snl_8dmJuD9Z2UkFfCj61pn7Zn_0hI0YOf9Cuw_XU3Uerv0","apiVersion":"1.0"}}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"events.subscribe","params":{"topics":["player.track","player.state"]}}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"player.toggle"}
```

## App identity (the token is bound to appId + identity key)

Sonolith derives it from the OS, first match wins:
1. Flatpak -> `flatpak:<app-id>`. The app needs `--filesystem=xdg-run/sonolith` (not `:ro`) to reach the socket.
2. AppImage (exe under a `.mount_*` dir and `APPIMAGE` env set) -> `appimage:<APPIMAGE path>`, versions in the
   file name become `*`.
3. Interpreter (python*, pythonw, node, nodejs, bun, deno, ruby*, perl*, sh, dash, bash, zsh, fish, pwsh,
   powershell, also `.exe`) -> `interp:<family>:<absolute script path>` (family keeps only the major version:
   python3.13 -> python3); `module:<name>` for `python -m`; `-` for inline code / interactive. Script = first
   non-option argument that is an existing file (skips `bun run`/`deno run`; `powershell` 5.1 needs `-File`).
4. Otherwise `exe:<path>`.
Version segments in paths become `*` (nvm, nvm-windows, pyenv, asdf, mise, Volta, fnm, Homebrew Cellar,
lib/python3.X, Windows PythonXY, /snap/<name>/<rev>, app-<ver>, WindowsApps). Keys are lower case on Windows. So
interpreter/version-manager/AppImage updates keep the identity; moving the app or script asks the user again.
`session.hello`, `app.info` and the `app.register` result return `identity`. Interpreter identity is weak by design
(same interpreter family + same script path = same app), which is fine for a same-user local API.

## Scopes (label = what the user sees)

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: scopes -->
- player:read ("See what's playing"): The current item, playback state, position, volume, shuffle and repeat.
- player:control ("Control playback"): Play, pause, skip, seek, volume, shuffle, repeat, episode speed, and starting a track, album, playlist or episode (which replaces the queue).
- queue:read ("See your queue"): The queue and autoplay.
- queue:write ("Change your queue"): Add, move and remove queue entries, clear the queue, turn autoplay on or off.
- library:read ("Access your library"): Playlists, liked songs, albums, artists, podcasts, episodes for later, history, and your ratings in returned items.
- library:write ("Change your library", sensitive): Create, rename and delete playlists, add and remove playlist items, like and dislike, save albums, playlists and podcasts.
- search ("Search YouTube Music"): Search, suggestions, and album, artist, podcast, episode and public playlist pages.
- lyrics:read ("Show lyrics"): Lyrics with timings for the current or any track, and live line and word events.
<!-- END GENERATED: scopes -->

Without `library:read`, `Track.rating`, `Episode.played` and `Episode.resumePositionMs` are null.
`playlist.get` works with `library:read` (any playlist) or `search` (public/unlisted only).

## Methods

Format: `name(params) -> result [scope] summary`. `?` = optional param.

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: methods -->
- app.info() -> ServerInfo [no session] Describes this Sonolith: API version, supported methods and topics, and the caller's session.
- app.register(appId: string, name: string, description: string, publisher: string, homepage?: string, icon?: string, scopes: ScopeRequest[], apiVersion: string) -> RegistrationPending [no session] Asks the user to let this app connect. Returns `pending` at once; the outcome arrives as `registration.resolved`.
- app.requestScopes(scopes: ScopeRequest[]) -> RequestScopesResult [session] Asks the user for more scopes. Shows a consent screen with only the new ones.
- app.unregister() -> {} [session] Removes this app from Sonolith and invalidates its token.
- session.hello(appId: string, token: string, apiVersion: string) -> HelloResult [no session] Authenticates the connection with the app's token.
- events.subscribe(topics: Topic[], positionHz?: integer (1–4)) -> SubscribeResult [session] Subscribes the connection to event topics. Sends a snapshot of each new topic right after the response.
- events.unsubscribe(topics: Topic[]) -> SubscribeResult [session] Removes topics from the connection's subscriptions.
- player.getState() -> PlayerState [player:read] Returns the full player state.
- player.play() -> {} [player:control] Starts or resumes playback.
- player.pause() -> {} [player:control] Pauses playback. Pausing while paused is not an error.
- player.toggle() -> {} [player:control] Plays when paused, pauses when playing.
- player.next() -> {} [player:control] Skips to the next item in the queue.
- player.previous() -> {} [player:control] Goes back like the Previous button: restarts the current item when more than 3 seconds have played, otherwise plays the previous item.
- player.seek(positionMs?: integer (ms), offsetMs?: integer) -> {} [player:control] Seeks in the current item. Pass exactly one of `positionMs` and `offsetMs`.
- player.setVolume(volume?: Volume, muted?: boolean) -> {} [player:control] Sets the volume, mute, or both. Pass at least one.
- player.setShuffle(enabled: boolean) -> {} [player:control] Turns shuffle on or off.
- player.setRepeat(mode: RepeatMode) -> {} [player:control] Sets the repeat mode.
- player.setRate(rate: EpisodeRate) -> {} [player:control] Sets the playback speed for podcast episodes. Tracks always play at 1.
- player.playItem(item: PlayableRef, startId?: string, shuffle?: boolean, positionMs?: integer (ms)) -> {} [player:control] Plays a track, episode, album, playlist or podcast. Replaces the queue.
- queue.get(fromIndex?: integer, cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> QueueSummary & {items: QueueEntry[], nextCursor: string | null} [queue:read] Returns the queue, one page at a time.
- queue.add(items: PlayableRef[]) -> {added: integer, queue: QueueSummary} [queue:write] Adds items to the end of the queue.
- queue.playNext(items: PlayableRef[]) -> {added: integer, queue: QueueSummary} [queue:write] Inserts items right after the current item.
- queue.move(entryId: string, toIndex: integer) -> {queue: QueueSummary} [queue:write] Moves one entry to a new index.
- queue.remove(entryIds: string[]) -> {removed: integer, queue: QueueSummary} [queue:write] Removes entries from the queue.
- queue.clear() -> {queue: QueueSummary} [queue:write] Removes every entry except the current one. Playback continues.
- queue.setAutoplay(enabled: boolean) -> {queue: QueueSummary} [queue:write] Turns autoplay on or off.
- library.playlists(cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> {items: Playlist[], nextCursor: string | null} [library:read] Lists the playlists in the user's library.
- library.likedSongs(cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> {items: MediaItem[], nextCursor: string | null} [library:read] Lists the user's liked songs, newest first.
- library.albums(cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> {items: Album[], nextCursor: string | null} [library:read] Lists the albums in the user's library.
- library.artists(cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> {items: Artist[], nextCursor: string | null} [library:read] Lists the artists in the user's library.
- library.podcasts(cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> {items: Podcast[], nextCursor: string | null} [library:read] Lists the podcast shows in the user's library.
- library.episodesForLater(cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> {items: Episode[], nextCursor: string | null} [library:read] Lists the episodes the user saved for later.
- library.history(cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> {items: HistoryEntry[], nextCursor: string | null} [library:read] Lists the user's listening history, newest first.
- playlist.get(id: string, cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> {playlist: PlaylistDetail, items: PlaylistEntry[], nextCursor: string | null} [library:read or search] Returns a playlist and its items, one page at a time.
- playlist.create(title: string, description?: string, privacy?: "public" | "unlisted" | "private", items?: MediaRef[]) -> Playlist [library:write] Creates a playlist in the user's library.
- playlist.rename(id: string, title: string) -> {} [library:write] Renames a playlist the user owns.
- playlist.delete(id: string) -> {} [library:write] Deletes a playlist the user owns. This cannot be undone.
- playlist.addTracks(id: string, items: MediaRef[], allowDuplicates?: boolean) -> {added: integer, skipped: integer} [library:write] Adds tracks or episodes to the end of a playlist the user owns.
- playlist.removeTracks(id: string, entryIds: string[]) -> {removed: integer} [library:write] Removes entries from a playlist the user owns.
- search.query(query: string, type?: "all" | "songs" | "videos" | "albums" | "artists" | "playlists" | "podcasts" | "episodes", cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> {topResult: Item | null, items: Item[], nextCursor: string | null} [search] Searches YouTube Music.
- search.suggestions(query: string) -> {queries: string[], items: Item[]} [search] Returns search suggestions for partial text.
- browse.album(id: string) -> AlbumDetail [search] Returns an album with all its tracks.
- browse.artist(id: string) -> ArtistDetail [search] Returns an artist page: description and shelves (top songs, albums, singles, videos, related artists, …).
- browse.podcast(id: string, cursor?: string, limit?: integer (1–100)) -> {podcast: PodcastDetail, items: Episode[], nextCursor: string | null} [search] Returns a podcast show and its episodes, newest first, one page at a time.
- browse.episode(id: string) -> EpisodeDetail [search] Returns an episode with its description.
- rating.set(item: RateableRef, rating: Rating) -> {} [library:write] Likes, dislikes or clears the rating of an item.
- lyrics.get(trackId?: string) -> LyricsResult [lyrics:read] Returns lyrics with timings for the current item or a given track.
<!-- END GENERATED: methods -->

## Events

`events.subscribe {topics, positionHz? (1–4)}` -> then one snapshot event per new topic, then events on change.
Events are JSON-RPC notifications: `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"player.trackChanged","params":{…}}`.
Not replayed after reconnect; subscribe again. Extrapolate position: `positionMs + (now - positionAt) * rate`.

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: events -->
- player.stateChanged: PlayerState [topic player.state, player:read] The player state changed (anything but the position moving on).
- player.trackChanged: {item: MediaItem | null} [topic player.track, player:read] A different item became current (or none).
- player.position: PositionEvent [topic player.position, player:read] The playback position, at the subscribed rate while playing.
- player.volumeChanged: {volume: Volume, muted: boolean} [topic player.volume, player:read] The volume or mute changed.
- queue.changed: QueueSummary & {reason: QueueChangeReason} [topic queue, queue:read] The queue's entries or current index changed.
- lyrics.changed: LyricsResult [topic lyrics, lyrics:read] Lyrics for the current item were found, improved, or cleared.
- lyrics.line: LyricsLineEvent [topic lyrics.line, lyrics:read] The line being sung changed.
- lyrics.word: LyricsWordEvent [topic lyrics.word, lyrics:read] A word or syllable started.
- account.changed: AccountState [topic account, no scope] The user signed in to or out of YouTube in Sonolith.
- registration.resolved: RegistrationOutcome [always delivered] A registration, scope or identity request was answered or expired.
- session.revoked: RevokeInfo [always delivered] The app's access was revoked. Sonolith closes the connection right after.
- session.scopesChanged: ScopesChanged [always delivered] The app's granted scopes changed.
<!-- END GENERATED: events -->

## Types

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: types -->
- ItemType = "track" | "episode" | "album" | "playlist" | "artist" | "podcast"
- Ref {type: ItemType, id: string}
- MediaRef {type: "track" | "episode", id: string}
- PlayableRef {type: "track" | "episode" | "album" | "playlist" | "podcast", id: string}
- RateableRef {type: "track" | "episode" | "album" | "playlist" | "podcast", id: string}
- Rating = "like" | "dislike" | "none"
- ArtistCredit {id: string | null, name: string}
- AlbumCredit {id: string | null, title: string}
- PodcastCredit {id: string | null, title: string}
- Track {type: "track", id: string, title: string, artists: ArtistCredit[], album: AlbumCredit | null, durationMs: integer (ms) | null, thumbnailUrl: string | null, explicit: boolean, video: boolean, rating: Rating | null}
- Episode {type: "episode", id: string, title: string, podcast: PodcastCredit | null, author: string | null, durationMs: integer (ms) | null, thumbnailUrl: string | null, publishedText: string | null, played: boolean | null, resumePositionMs: integer (ms) | null}
- MediaItem = Track | Episode
- Album {type: "album", id: string, title: string, artists: ArtistCredit[], albumType: "album" | "single" | "ep" | null, year: integer | null, thumbnailUrl: string | null, explicit: boolean}
- Playlist {type: "playlist", id: string, title: string, author: string | null, trackCount: integer | null, thumbnailUrl: string | null, editable: boolean | null}
- Artist {type: "artist", id: string, name: string, thumbnailUrl: string | null, subscribersText: string | null}
- Podcast {type: "podcast", id: string, title: string, author: string | null, thumbnailUrl: string | null}
- Item = Track | Episode | Album | Playlist | Artist | Podcast
- AlbumDetail = Album + {description: string | null, trackCount: integer, durationMs: integer (ms) | null, tracks: Track[]}
- PlaylistDetail = Playlist + {description: string | null, privacy: "public" | "unlisted" | "private" | null}
- ArtistSection {kind: "songs" | "albums" | "singles" | "videos" | "playlists" | "episodes" | "related" | "other", title: string, items: Item[]}
- ArtistDetail = Artist + {description: string | null, sections: ArtistSection[]}
- PodcastDetail = Podcast + {description: string | null}
- EpisodeDetail = Episode + {description: string | null}
- PlaylistEntry {entryId: string | null, item: MediaItem}
- HistoryEntry {item: MediaItem, sectionText: string | null}
- PlaybackStatus = "playing" | "paused" | "buffering" | "stopped"
- RepeatMode = "off" | "all" | "one"
- EpisodeRate = 0.5 | 0.75 | 1 | 1.25 | 1.5 | 1.75 | 2 | 2.5 | 3
- PlayerState {status: PlaybackStatus, item: MediaItem | null, positionMs: integer (ms), positionAt: integer (ms since epoch), durationMs: integer (ms) | null, volume: Volume, muted: boolean, shuffle: boolean, repeat: RepeatMode, rate: number, episodeRate: EpisodeRate, canGoNext: boolean, canGoPrevious: boolean, queueIndex: integer | null, queueLength: integer, autoplay: boolean}
- QueueEntry {index: integer, entryId: string, item: MediaItem, autoplay: boolean}
- QueueSummary {revision: integer, currentIndex: integer | null, length: integer, autoplay: boolean}
- QueueChangeReason = "replaced" | "added" | "removed" | "moved" | "cleared" | "advanced" | "autoplay" | "other"
- PositionEvent {positionMs: integer (ms), positionAt: integer (ms since epoch), durationMs: integer (ms) | null, rate: number, status: PlaybackStatus}
- LyricsTier = "word" | "line" | "unsynced"
- LyricWord {startMs: integer (ms), endMs: integer (ms), text: string}
- LyricLine {startMs: integer (ms) | null, endMs: integer (ms) | null, text: string, words: LyricWord[], background: LyricWord[]}
- Lyrics {trackId: string, tier: LyricsTier, provider: string, providerName: string, attribution: string | null, lines: LyricLine[]}
- LyricsResult {trackId: string, status: "found" | "notFound" | "instrumental", lyrics: Lyrics | null}
- LyricsLineEvent {trackId: string, lineIndex: integer | null, text: string | null, startMs: integer (ms) | null, endMs: integer (ms) | null, positionMs: integer (ms)}
- LyricsWordEvent {trackId: string, lineIndex: integer, wordIndex: integer, background: boolean, positionMs: integer (ms)}
- ScopeRequest {scope: Scope, required: boolean, reason: string}
- RegistrationPending {status: "pending", requestId: string, expiresAt: integer (ms since epoch), identity: AppIdentity}
- RequestScopesResult {status: "pending" | "granted", requestId: string | null, expiresAt: integer (ms since epoch) | null, grantedScopes: Scope[]}
- RegistrationOutcome {requestId: string, kind: "register" | "scopes" | "identity", status: "approved" | "denied" | "blocked" | "expired", token: string | null, grantedScopes: Scope[] | null, retryAfterMs: integer | null}
- AppIdentity {kind: "executable" | "interpreter" | "appimage" | "flatpak", key: string, executable: string, interpreter: string | null, script: string | null, appImage: string | null, flatpakId: string | null}
- HelloResult {apiVersion: string, appVersion: string, appId: string, grantedScopes: Scope[], signedIn: boolean, identity: AppIdentity}
- SessionInfo {appId: string, grantedScopes: Scope[], signedIn: boolean, identity: AppIdentity}
- ServerInfo {apiVersion: string, appVersion: string, platform: "linux" | "windows", methods: string[], topics: Topic[], session: SessionInfo | null}
- Topic = "player.state" | "player.track" | "player.position" | "player.volume" | "queue" | "lyrics" | "lyrics.line" | "lyrics.word" | "account"
- SubscribeResult {topics: Topic[], positionHz: integer (1–4)}
- RevokeInfo {reason: "removed" | "blocked" | "unregistered" | "replaced"}
- ScopesChanged {grantedScopes: Scope[], added: Scope[], removed: Scope[]}
- AccountState {signedIn: boolean}
<!-- END GENERATED: types -->

## Errors

`error.data` always has `name` and `reason`; match on `code` or `data.name`. Common to all methods: InvalidRequest,
InvalidParams, InternalError, RateLimited, Unavailable, Timeout (+ SessionRequired, PermissionDenied where relevant).

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: errors -->
- -32700 ParseError: The line is not valid UTF-8 JSON. -> Fix the client. The connection stays open.
- -32600 InvalidRequest: Not a valid JSON-RPC 2.0 request object, a batch, a message over the size limit (Sonolith then closes the connection), or a call not allowed in the connection's state. -> Fix the client. See `data.reason`.
- -32601 MethodNotFound: No such method in this Sonolith. -> Check `app.info` `methods`; the method may be newer than this Sonolith.
- -32602 InvalidParams: Missing, unknown or invalid parameters, or an expired cursor. -> Fix the call. `data.path` points at the parameter; `data.reason` is `cursorExpired` when a cursor is too old.
- -32603 InternalError: Sonolith failed unexpectedly. -> Retry later; report it if it repeats.
- -32001 NotRegistered: The `appId` is not registered (never registered, unregistered, or removed by the user). -> Delete the stored token. Show "Disconnected from Sonolith". Register again only after a user action.
- -32002 Unauthorized: The token is wrong or has been revoked. -> Delete the stored token. Show "Disconnected from Sonolith". Register again only after a user action.
- -32003 PermissionDenied: The app lacks the scope in `data.scope`. -> Do not retry. Hide the feature, or ask for the scope with `app.requestScopes` after a user action.
- -32004 RegistrationPending: A request is already waiting for the user, or the app identity changed and the user must approve it again. -> Wait for `registration.resolved` with `data.requestId` on the connection that made the request.
- -32005 RegistrationDenied: The user denied a recent request; asking again is on hold. -> Do not ask again before `data.retryAfterMs`, and then only after a user action.
- -32006 Blocked: The user blocked this app. -> Stop. Tell the user the app can be unblocked in Sonolith's Settings → Connected apps.
- -32007 NotSignedIn: The method needs a YouTube account and the user is signed out. -> Tell the user to sign in in Sonolith; subscribe to `account` to know when they do.
- -32008 NotFound: The item does not exist or is not visible to this app. -> Do not retry with the same id.
- -32009 RateLimited: The app exceeded its rate limit or its in-flight request limit. -> Wait `data.retryAfterMs`, then retry.
- -32010 Unavailable: The action is not possible right now (for example, nothing is playing, or Sonolith is still starting). -> See `data.reason`; retry after `data.retryAfterMs` when present.
- -32011 Timeout: YouTube, a lyrics source or Sonolith did not answer in time. -> Retry later with backoff.
- -32012 SessionRequired: The method needs an authenticated session. -> Call `session.hello` first.
- -32013 UnsupportedVersion: Sonolith does not support the requested API major version. -> Tell the user to update Sonolith or the app. `data.supported` lists the supported majors.
<!-- END GENERATED: errors -->

## Limits

16 requests in flight per connection; 8 connections per app; authenticate within 30 s; answers within 30 s.
Rate classes per app: local 50/s, control 10/s, network 2/s, account 1 per 2 s (30/min), auth 1/s per connection.
On RateLimited wait `data.retryAfterMs`. Prefer events over polling.

## Examples

Complete clients (Python, Node/TypeScript) and shell one-liners: https://github.com/opecko/sonolith/tree/master/api/examples

## Integration checklist

1. Connect via discovery.json (Windows: only its pipe name; check server pid).
2. One JSON message per line, ≤ 1 MiB; match by id; ignore unknown fields/notifications.
3. Register only on a user action, with a stable appId, clear name/description/publisher and a plain reason per
   scope; ask only for what you use.
4. Keep the connection open while pending; handle approved/denied/blocked/expired.
5. Store the token in a secret store (fallback: user-only file); never log or show it.
6. `session.hello` first on every connection; handle Unauthorized, NotRegistered, Blocked, RegistrationPending,
   UnsupportedVersion.
7. Use only grantedScopes; handle session.scopesChanged and PermissionDenied.
8. On session.revoked / Unauthorized / NotRegistered: stop, delete token, show "Disconnected from Sonolith".
9. Never re-register automatically.
10. Visible "Disconnect from Sonolith" -> app.unregister + delete token.
11. Reconnect with backoff (1 s -> 60 s, jitter); never spawn Sonolith repeatedly; resubscribe after reconnect.
12. Use events, not polling.
13. Respect rate limits (retryAfterMs).
14. Handle Unavailable, Timeout, NotSignedIn, NotFound, cursorExpired.
15. Test with Sonolith not running, API off, and Sonolith quitting mid-session.
16. Test deny, block, expiry, unticked optional scope, removal in Sonolith while connected, disconnect.
